original_test_intent: Verify every SMBIOS Type 9 System Slot Type enum describes the approved slot technology and generation for its exact board/riser slot, remains consistent with the separate width/length fields, and persists after reboot.
original_method: Collect complete raw/decoded Type 9 records, preserve the raw slot-type enum with designation, slot ID, width, length, usage and bus address, compare to a versioned board/riser specification, then repeat after an approved reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves the slot-type map, SMBIOS enum version and reboot plan. Physical slot inspection or live PCIe capability testing is optional separate scope.
required_inputs: Expected raw/decoded System Slot Type per designation/slot ID
Applicable SMBIOS version including newly defined PCIe generation/form-factor values
Expected Data Bus Width and Slot Length relationships
Policy for Other/Unknown/vendor values and approved reboot/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS and optional read-only PCI queries; do not insert/remove cards or alter link settings.
Preserve the raw enum because older decoders may render newer slot types as out-of-spec or Unknown.
Do not conflate System Slot Type with the separate Data Bus Width, Slot Length or negotiated link width/speed.
Do not infer physical connector population or live electrical capability solely from firmware metadata.
Stop on unsupported decoding, cross-field inconsistency, record drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Decode each raw Type 9 slot-type enum against the applicable SMBIOS version and compare its exact slot identity and cross-field consistency before/after reboot.
Do not manipulate slots, run destructive PCI operations or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the platform slot-type/generation map and exception rules.
Approve reboot/recovery, request any separate physical/link validation if needed, and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The field target is correct, but grep loses raw enum, exact slot identity and the width/length fields needed to detect an internally inconsistent Type 9 record.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 9 records and validate each slot-type enum using the declared SMBIOS version, exact slot identity and separate width/length fields before and after reboot.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The System Slot Type scope, Type 9 script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Compare raw System Slot Type bytes and decoded labels to the applicable SMBIOS enumeration and exact board/riser map, then independently verify logical consistency with Data Bus Width and Slot Length fields.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 9 implementations across legacy and PCI Express slot generations.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS, board/riser and dmidecode/parser versions; flag when the decoder predates the emitted enum.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 9 System Slot Type enumeration, approved platform slot specification and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw-enum/version validation and cross-field consistency instead of trusting a decoder label fragment.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; distinguishes firmware errors from decoder-version gaps and avoids treating negotiated link state as slot type.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Versioned slot technology map and Type 9 cross-field expectations.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Firmware-declared type does not prove the installed card's negotiated generation or physical wiring.

project_override_considerations: A project may define alternate riser slot types, but the override must name the exact board/riser and slot ID, preserve the raw value and keep bus width and live-link acceptance separate.
expected_evidence: Approved board/riser revisions, exact slot-type map, SMBIOS enum version and exception policy
Complete pre-reboot Type 9 records with handle, designation, slot ID, raw/decoded type, width, length, usage and supported bus address
Per-slot enum and cross-field consistency results
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot record diff
Engineer verdict; optional physical/live-link evidence separately identified

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently identifies the Type 9 System Slot Type metadata and persistence check.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The enum is readable and version-aware comparison is automatable; an unavailable platform map is a readiness input.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw enum, decoder-version detection, exact topology identity and width/length separation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains the owner map and physical safety limits while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification under V3.1.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Distinguishes metadata capability from optional live PCIe validation and engineer-owned verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents an outdated decoder's Unknown label from being treated as a firmware failure and prevents width or negotiated-link data from being substituted for slot type.
independent_technical_reasoning: System Slot Type is a structured, versioned SMBIOS enum; raw decoding and exact-slot comparison are deterministic after the platform map is supplied.
